title: Rosemary Beach: Coconut Crab in Seacrest Beach – Rosemary Beach®
meta_description: Rosemary Beach: Coconut Crab in Seacrest Beach. Welcome to your perfect getaway! This newly built 4-bedroom, 4.
description_expanded:
Property includes private beach access at Sunset Beach, and pool access at the large Lagoon Pool. Beach service chairs can be rented through La Dolce Vita. Complimentary access to Rosemary Beach® Fitness and complimentary court time at Rosemary Beach® Racquet Club also included.

Welcome to your perfect getaway! This newly built 4-bedroom, 4.5-bathroom home in Seacrest Beach offers a blend of modern elegance and thoughtful comfort, making it the ideal destination for families or groups seeking a luxurious retreat.

On the main floor, you’ll find a spacious open concept living area. The kitchen is a standout feature with its large island, new appliances, and soft light blue accents that add a touch of coastal charm. Adjacent to the kitchen is a large dining table, perfect for gathering and sharing meals. The living room flows seamlessly into the outdoor patio, which is furnished with comfortable lounge seating and accessed through sliding glass doors. For convenience, a half bath is also located on this floor. The primary bedroom is a serene retreat with a king bed and a spa-like bathroom that includes a double vanity, a spacious shower, and a soaking tub.

Upstairs, a second living room provides an additional space to relax, complete with access to a private balcony where you can enjoy the fresh coastal air. This level features three guest ensuite bedrooms: a queen bedroom, a twin bedroom, and a king bedroom that boasts its own a private balcony. A full laundry room is also located on the second floor, ensuring convenience during your stay.

This home includes four complimentary adult bikes, allowing you to explore the area with ease. There is parking for up to five vehicles, making it easy to bring your whole group. Guests also enjoy access to Seacrest Beach, with a convenient tram service to the shore, as well as the Seacrest community pool. For those looking to stay active, access to Rosemary Beach fitness and tennis facilities is also included.

Combining luxury, comfort, and an unbeatable location, Coconut Crab is the ultimate choice for your next coastal escape.

PROPERTY REQUIRES A 7 NIGHT MINIMUM SATURDAY TO SATURDAY DURING SPRING BREAK AND SUMMER
